JPMorgan's shift to neutral/bearish post-Warsh signals Wall Street repricing.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but conditional. AI capex cycle remains intact but Goldman's 'shocker' warning suggests a 2027 correction risk. $40T US debt and G20 growth agenda create fiscal tailwind if managed. Insurance M&A (Aon/USI) and pharma consolidation (Lilly/Merida) support selective earnings growth. EM structural outperformance likely continues. Key risk: if rate-hike cycle extends into 2027, equity multiples compress 10-15%. Gold and energy remain structural hedges.
